audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all three trailer events: Penny and Pam’s argument, Penny’s recipe tasting, and Pam’s potato juice delivery. Every dialogue line, embedded question, response choice, conditional branch, gender branch, and character voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical saloon, Joja-world, and character terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship changes, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
